query:
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company,
  COUNT(m.id) as totalMeetings
FROM delegateProfiles dp
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId AND m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
WHERE dp.attendeeId IN ('192905181704','5140258','194698768792','116903349643','185464523694','452351','8713772','190937723960','93137898669','16427701','910801','21545051','183232510638','91862579761','93380106578','12731251','18336501','191181142545')
GROUP BY dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company
HAVING totalMeetings > 0
ORDER BY totalMeetings DESC;
